manager_convergence.interpretation: The manager reached an exact textual fixed point before the final worker layer.

worker_homogenization.interpretation: Recursive broadcast eliminated implementation diversity while the independent control retained three distinct solutions.

mechanism_trace: The manager repeatedly stated a highest-to-lowest arg > file > env > default rule, while the public specification and examples/tests encode an order-sensitive lower-to-higher override process with early parse-error stopping.
The manager retained an integer parser that returned the original digit string, preserving 0042 instead of normalizing it to 42.
From layer 2 onward, the manager recommended a unified schema-loading exception message that did not reliably include the word JSON.
All three layer-5 recursive workers copied the resulting playbook into the same implementation and therefore shared exactly the same five failures.

scientific_interpretation.supported: Core-only local verification plus centralized recursive synthesis can homogenize independent workers around a stable, locally verified but globally inferior implementation.
scientific_interpretation.not_supported: This run does not show a progressively worsening degradation curve, and it does not isolate amplification of experience that remains globally correct. The manager imported specification errors and then converged.
scientific_interpretation.iteration_hypothesis: More layers are unlikely to change this pair because the manager was already byte-identical at layers 3 and 4 and all layer-5 worker snapshots were identical.
